title: Korean-Style Chicken Pasta
description: A fusion dish that combines the flavors of Korea and Italy. This quick and easy recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Noodles
ingredients.notes: any type of noodle, such as rice noodles or udon

instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the Korean-style chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the soy sauce, gochujang, garlic, and green onions to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
In a separate pan, cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
To assemble the dish, place a serving of the pasta mixture on a plate, then top with a serving of the noodles.
